duas.title: Feeling Sad or Depressed
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayni, wa ghalabatir-rijal.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.

duas.title: Feeling Overwhelmed or Helpless
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith.
duas.meaning: O Ever-Living One, O Self-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I seek assistance.

duas.title: Feeling Anxious or Stressed
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallah wa ni'mal-Wakeel.
duas.meaning: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.

duas.title: Dealing with a Hardship
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahlan.
duas.meaning: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

duas.title: Feeling Heartbroken
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khairan minha.
duas.meaning: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

duas.title: Feeling Angry
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan.

duas.title: Feeling Lonely or Isolated
duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul warithin.
duas.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.

duas.title: Feeling Sick or Weak
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adhibil-ba'sa, ishkfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman.
duas.meaning: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the hardship. Heal, You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

duas.title: Feeling Scared or Fearful
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.title: Seeking Forgiveness (Tawbah)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-'Azimal-ladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyal-Qayyuma wa atubu ilayh.
duas.meaning: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty, whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Sustainer of all, and I repent to Him.

duas.title: Feeling Confused (Seeking Guidance)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahummah-dini wa saddidni.
duas.meaning: O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path.

duas.title: Lacking Confidence
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
duas.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

duas.title: Seeking Patience (Sabr)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimeen.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

duas.title: Feeling Hopeless
duas.arabic: لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: La taqnatu min rahmatillah.
duas.meaning: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

duas.title: Overthinking (Restless Mind)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma gharatin-nujumu wa hada'atil-'uyunu wa anta Hayyun Qayyum.
duas.meaning: O Allah, the stars have set and the eyes have rested, but You are the Ever-Living, the All-Sustaining.

duas.title: Protection from Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammatin.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous reptile, and from every envious evil eye.

duas.title: When Insulted by Someone
duas.arabic: وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا
duas.transliteration: Wa idha khatabahumul-jahiloona qaloo salaman.
duas.meaning: And when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace.

duas.title: Feeling Ungrateful
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya.
duas.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me.

duas.title: Fear of Showing Off (Shirk)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for that which I do not know.

duas.title: For Parents (Love & Mercy)
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
duas.meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

duas.title: Seeking a Good End
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الْخَاتِمَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka husnal-khatimah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for a good end to my life.

duas.title: Overburdened by Debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bifadhlika 'amman siwak.
duas.meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

duas.title: Seeking Good Character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummah-dini li ahsanil-akhlaq, la yahdi li ahsaniha illa ant.
duas.meaning: O Allah, guide me to the best of characters, for none can guide to it except You.

duas.title: Protection from Hellfire
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajirni minan-nar.
duas.meaning: O Allah, save me from the Fire.

duas.title: Seeking Paradise
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise.

duas.title: When Praised by Others
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaqulun, waghfir li ma la ya'lamun.
duas.meaning: O Allah, do not hold me to account for what they say, and forgive me for what they do not know.

duas.title: Avoiding Fitnah (Trials)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, and from the trials of life and death.

duas.title: Indecisiveness (Need Guidance)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خِرْ لِي وَاخْتَرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma khir li wakhtar li.
duas.meaning: O Allah, choose for me and select for me (what is best).

duas.title: When Feeling Forgetful
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.

duas.title: Seeking Beneficial Knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds.

duas.title: Overcoming Stinginess
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي شُحَّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini shuhha nafsi.
duas.meaning: O Allah, protect me from the evils of my own soul's greed.

duas.title: Increasing Love for Allah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuk.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Your love and the love of those who love You.

duas.title: After a Bad Dream
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tamati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi wa sharri 'ibadih.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, His punishment, and the evil of His slaves.

duas.title: Doubt in Faith (Waswasah)
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.transliteration: Amantu billahi wa rusulih.
duas.meaning: I believe in Allah and His Messengers.

duas.title: Seeking Protection from Harm
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
duas.meaning: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing and All-Knowing.

duas.title: Waking Up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur.
duas.meaning: All praise is due to Allah, who gave us life after taking it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.title: Before Sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
duas.meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Before an Exam or Hard Task
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
duas.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Leaving the House
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-lahi, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.title: Entering the House
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala rabbina tawakkalna.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.

duas.title: Before Eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah.

duas.title: Forgetting Bismillah Before Eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah, in its beginning and its end.

duas.title: After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghairi hawlin minni wa la quwwatin.
duas.meaning: All praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any strength or power on my part.

duas.title: Entering the Restroom
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil spirits.

duas.title: Leaving the Restroom
duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.transliteration: Ghufranaka.
duas.meaning: I ask Your forgiveness.

duas.title: Traveling / Starting a Journey
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin. Wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
duas.meaning: Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have otherwise subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return.

duas.title: Getting Dressed
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghairi hawlin minni wa la quwwatin.
duas.meaning: All Praise is to Allah Who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.

duas.title: Looking in the Mirror
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta hassanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi.
duas.meaning: O Allah, just as You have made my physical form beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.

duas.title: When it Rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an.
duas.meaning: O Allah, (bring) beneficial rain clouds.

duas.title: After Wudu (Ablution)
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.
duas.meaning: I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without any partners, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

duas.title: Going to the Mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahummaj-'al fi qalbi nuran.
duas.meaning: O Allah, place light in my heart.

duas.title: Entering the Mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummaf-tah li abwaba rahmatik.
duas.meaning: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.

duas.title: Leaving the Mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

duas.title: Hearing the Adhan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadhilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the honored station You have promised him.

duas.title: When Sneezing
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah.

duas.title: Hearing someone Sneeze
duas.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Yarhamukallah.
duas.meaning: May Allah have mercy upon you.

duas.title: Replying to the Sneezer
duas.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.transliteration: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
duas.meaning: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

duas.title: Entering the Market
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa Huwa Hayyun la yamut, bi yadihil-khayru, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things omnipotent.

duas.title: Visiting the Sick
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha' Allah.
duas.meaning: No worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Breaking Fast (Iftar)
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in sha' Allah.
duas.meaning: The thirst has gone, the veins are quenched, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Hearing Thunder
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min kheefatih.
duas.meaning: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels extol from fear of Him.

duas.title: During Strong Winds
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for its good and seek refuge in You from its evil.

duas.title: Seeing the New Moon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam, Rabbi wa Rabbuk-Allah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

duas.title: Drinking Milk
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu.
duas.meaning: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

duas.title: Wearing New Clothes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, all praise is to You. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made.

duas.title: When Someone Offers You a Meal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma at'im man at'amani wasqi man saqani.
duas.meaning: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me and give drink to the one who has given me drink.

duas.title: Seeing Early Fruits
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fi thamarina, wa barik lana fi madinatina.
duas.meaning: O Allah, bless our fruits for us, and bless our city for us.

duas.title: Entering a Graveyard
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Assalamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin.
duas.meaning: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the dwellings, believers and Muslims.

duas.title: Returning Home (From Journey)
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna, li-Rabbina hamidun.
duas.meaning: We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

duas.title: Hearing a Rooster
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

duas.title: Hearing a Dog Bark
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

duas.title: Ending a Meeting / Assembly
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
duas.meaning: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

duas.title: Seeing Someone in Affliction
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi 'afani mimmab-talaka bihi, wa faddalani 'ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.
duas.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.

duas.title: Looking at the Sky
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: For a Newlywed Couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr.
duas.meaning: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.

duas.title: Laylatul Qadr (Night of Decree)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.
duas.meaning: O Allah, You are forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
